observations.text: Skills are community-authored agent recipes (slugs like /pixar-animated-ad-creator, /viral-video-replicator, /neo-chinese-aesthetic-tvc, /hujinquanwuxia) with declared inputs (如何使用: '一份剧本或一句话，可选人脸/造型参考图') and outputs (输出内容: '角色/道具/场景资产图、逐镜分镜表格、仙侠短剧视频成片'). The marketplace headline reads '从 Skill 出发，抵达成片' / '全开，故事走起'.
A skill is applied by inserting it as a chip into the Agent composer (aria-label '使用 Skill …'); 添加 Skill in the detail modal adds it to the user's set (收藏 tab).

Skills are the agent's planning unit: the same composer exists on tv-home, /skill and inside the canvas Agent drawer, and sending from home lands the run in a canvas project (not verified by sending — credits were 0).
CLI & Skill button in the canvas Agent drawer produced no visible overlay; what 'CLI' refers to is unknown.
